[[File:Royal Library.jpg|thumb|right|A map of the Royal Library of Cairhien.]]

The '''Royal Library of Cairhien''' is one of the great wonders of the world, a vast treasure trove consisting of tens of thousands of books on every conceivable subject. It is located within the [[Cairhien (city)|city of Cairhien]], within an impressive and large stone structure. The Royal Library is one of the greatest treasures of the kingdom of [[Cairhien]] and as a depository of knowledge, it is second only to the [[Great Library]] of the [[White Tower]] in [[Tar Valon]].

The Royal Library was one of the few buildings in the city not torched by the [[Aiel]] during the [[First Battle of Cairhien]]. The Aiel consider knowledge to be precious and will not destroy a book of knowledge.
